title: Allegations against Vesta Realty continue with tenant at the Putnam Green Apartments - NewsBreak
text:
By Lauren Henry/KFOR ,
5 hours ago
OKLAHOMA CITY ( KFOR ) – Another tenant at a Vesta Realty property is speaking out about poor living conditions and a lack of maintenance, this time at the Putnam Green Apartments.
“In my dishwasher, there is cockroaches, as you can see. And usually there’s not just one, there’s usually multiple,” Summer Coleman, a resident at the Putnam Green Apartments, said.
Coleman says she has lived at the apartment complex since October 2025.
She says the heater in her apartment stopped working in December, and she has been without a working air conditioning unit since April.
“When I try to turn it on, my heater smokes, the smoke alarm will come on, and then it starts in the walls like it’ll start a fire in the walls. I’ve had to call the fire department,” Coleman said.
Coleman says she’s made multiple maintenance requests, but they go unanswered.
“They will tell me, okay, we’re going to go fix it, and then they’ll wait a week, don’t ever show up, and then they just market as complete,” Coleman said.
Judge decides to remove Vesta Realty as the property management company for SW OKC apartment complex The issues with the heat and air conditioner aren’t the only problems the apartments have. According to Coleman, her apartment and others have a cockroach infestation.
“They won’t even come in and spray,” Coleman said.
As Coleman opened her dishwasher, a cockroach scurried across the inside. She says this is a normal occurrence in her kitchen, despite cleaning multiple times a day.
“When I’m cooking and stuff like that, they will fall from this fan right here into my pots. They will fall in my food like meat, anything. They will just fall in the food, and it’s just a waste,” Coleman said.
Despite the problems, Coleman still pays her rent and has even paid out of pocket to try to control the pest problem on her own.
“I’ve paid over $200 worth of stuff to kill the cockroaches, and it does not help. I’ve went down to the apartment office and asked them, ‘Hey, can you take this off my rent? Because I paid out of pocket for this’ and they will not do it,” Coleman said.
Vesta Realty CEO. Marc Kulick has been at the center of multiple lawsuits alleging he has mismanaged company funds to support his lifestyle, including high-stakes gambling, while he fails to properly maintain his properties.
A spokesperson with Vesta Realty refused to do an interview today and told News 4 in a statement, “We take resident concerns seriously and are looking into the allegations you shared.”
The City of Stillwater stepped in to help tenants at a Vesta property in their area, declaring Remington Ranch a public nuisance.
News 4 asked the City of Oklahoma City about the allegations of poor living conditions at the Putnam Green Apartments. They responded, saying:
We encourage Oklahoma City residents to call the Action Center if they have safety concerns, including issues with water and heat and air problems with their rental. The can submit concerns to OKC.gov/action. We will send an inspector and work with the property manager to correct the problem.
